subject: COI endorsement scope & PO cutover plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: COI endorsement scope & PO cutover plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks for moving this forward. To keep LumenWorks on track for activation, procurement needs the Certificate of Insurance (COI) to include the following endorsements and language before we can finalize the supplier record:

- Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Primary and Non-Contributory wording that applies to our contract

Please confirm whether the COI you just sent (or an endorsement) can include the exact wording below: 

"Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are included as Additional Insured with coverage primary and non-contributory to any insurance maintained by Redwood Inference."

If the carrier prefers to issue an endorsement rather than re-issuing the COI, that is fine — we just need a carrier-signed endorsement document that references the policy number and expressly grants the above.

Operational notes:
- Finance can issue a conditional PO (limited value) if endorsement is pending, but we need an estimated timeframe for the endorsement and a plan to deliver it.
- If endorsement will take longer than 15 business days, please let us know so we can evaluate alternative cashflow options.

I attached our PO draft for reference (you can ignore the dollar figure for now) and a short checklist of required COI items.

[Attachment: PO_draft_56789.docx (DOCX, 34KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_COI_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

Appreciate a quick confirmation and ETA.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: COI endorsement scope & PO cutover plan

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attached is the current COI we have on file. It shows coverage limits but does not currently include the Additional Insured endorsement language you outlined. Our broker tells me they can issue an endorsement but need the exact "additional insured" text as it should appear and confirmation of Redwood's EIN to reference on the endorsement.

Questions from our side:
- Is the EIN required on the endorsement or can the endorsement reference "Redwood Inference, Inc." without the EIN?
- You mentioned a conditional PO — will Redwood accept a conditional PO for 30 days while the endorsement is processed?

We can request the endorsement today but need the written language and a contact at your broker to accelerate. ETA per broker: 5–10 business days once requested (sometimes sooner).

Attached: LumenWorks_COI_2027-09.pdf (current COI)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
VP, Strategic Partnerships
LumenWorks
elena.ruiz@lumenworks.com
[Attachment: LumenWorks_COI_2027-09.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: COI endorsement scope & PO cutover plan

Elena —

Thanks for the quick reply and for attaching the COI. A few clarifications:

- EIN: preferred but not strictly required on the endorsement. If your carrier needs it, please use: 12-3456789 and confirm on the endorsement.
- Exact additional-insured wording we need on the endorsement: 
  "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees, and agents are added as Additional Insured with coverage primary and non-contributory to any insurance maintained by Redwood Inference."

Operational approach:
- Marcus (cc'd) in Finance: can Redwood issue a conditional PO for onboarding while the endorsement is processed? If yes, what are the terms?
- Priyom (cc'd) in Risk: please advise if the attached COI is otherwise acceptable while the endorsement is pending. Any issues we should flag?

If your broker can commit to <=7 business days, we are comfortable issuing a conditional PO (limited value) to start the integration work. If longer, we'll need to escalate to Contracts for an alternative arrangement.

Regards,
Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@lumenworks.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: COI endorsement scope & PO cutover plan

Neha / Elena —

Finance can approve a conditional PO to enable a limited cutover of services, subject to the following:

- Endorsement must be issued within 15 business days of PO date and provided to Redwood Procurement.
- Endorsement must reference the policy number shown on the COI and include the Additional Insured language exactly as Neha provided.
- PO will be limited to an initial pilot value (we will confirm the value in a separate DocuSign).
- If endorsement is not received in the timeframe above, the PO will be paused and no further invoices will be processed until evidence is received.

Elena — please let us know if your broker can commit to issuing the endorsement within 15 business days. If they can confirm a faster ETA (<=7 business days), we can relax the conditional hold period accordingly.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

- I am attaching the broker ticket confirmation for your records.
- We accept the conditional PO terms as outlined. Please share the PO when ready and we will begin provisioning against the pilot value.
